rationale: User approved study-count-targeted15% fixed independent test plus grouped five-fold CV on the85% development pool. Patients never cross groups. Both binary outcome classes must occur in test and each validation fold; individual burden scores are soft balancing targets because rare scores have too few independent patients. Minimize study-count deviation before label imbalance. Fixed seed42; no model-performance-driven selection. Five fold_n/patient_split.parquet files define each fold; all five share fixed test patients and match the study index lists. No root patient_split.parquet is produced. Shared raw-feature reports use fold_1; model training selects the corresponding fold_n table. Final single model may refit on development after CV.
